title: 第3章 帮你也帮他们第4章 雷雨
slug: 老乡你咋还会搓火球嘞
content_zh:
即使举行这次游行示威的学生从来都看不上张绝，张绝却清楚地明白。
这帮学生确确实实是在为国为民着想。
旧法绝没有再复辟的可能。
新时代的浪潮下，曾经依靠旧法统治压迫这片土地的后金鼠妖，在洋人的新法面前不堪一击。
世界已经变了，从后金延续到新民国的百年屈辱证实了旧法的不可行，只有新思想、新职业、新风气才能孕育出一条适合这片土地的崭新道路出来。
这一点，不管是在新民国的宪法上，还是公允教会的教义上，亦或是这片土地无数人们的心中都是毋庸置疑的真理！
而江南总督为了一把和旧法有关的剑大动干戈就是在倒行逆施，学生们对此示威游行是绝对进步且正义的行为。
在这种情况下，就算是再霸道的军阀都会感到头疼，因为投效到他们麾下的那些兵，也全都是学习新法的职业者，就算在自己人这里，也得不到什么支持。
可安焕然居然敢就这样下令开枪抓人！
这位已经在江南统治了近二十年之久的军阀，到底怎么想的张绝不得而知，也没时间去想了。
在枪声响起，宪警开始抓人的那一刻，整个江宁城就乱成了一锅粥。
不管是示威的学生，还是原本在街上看热闹的商贩走卒，宪警们见人就打，看见学生就抓。
有不知道多少无辜路人被打得头破血流，并且只要穿着文明装的学生，不论有没有参加游行全都被一顿毒打后抓了起来。
井水巷距离学生们聚在一起示威游行的大街并不远，这场动乱很快就波及到了这条巷子。
有十多个学生逃到了这里，他们有人在惊慌地拍门，希望能寻求庇护，有人干脆直接翻进了院子，不等主人家答应就找地方躲了起来。
张绝在听到隔壁老张的提醒后，就立刻躲进家里，锁死了家门，但外面传来的那些动静声，却还是能清晰地传到他的耳中。
“汪汪汪！”旺财在狂吠，那声音凄厉且愤怒。
“大娘！大娘！求求你们了！帮帮忙吧！帮帮忙！让我们进去躲一躲！躲一躲！”
“啊！别打我！别打我！我没反对大帅！我只是在旁边看看！只是在旁边看看！”
“你们这帮助纣为虐的畜生！安焕然是在冒天下之大不韪！他会遭天谴的！你们也会遭天谴的！”

“抓我吧！把我抓走！别抓他们！这件事和那些无辜的人没有关系！”
张绝透过门缝，看到了四散而逃的学生被后面挥舞着警棍的宪警们追捕殴打着。
原本宁和平静的井水巷，仿佛在一瞬之间就变成了血腥的刑场。
有两名学生翻墙躲进了老刘头家，隔壁李婶在宪警没追过来之前就急忙拉着三名学生进了家门帮他们躲藏，还有几个不像是学生打扮的人在哭喊着拍老张家的门。
就在这个时候，张绝看到了一个有些面熟的身影正慌忙从巷子中跑过。
在他就要从张绝家门前经过的时候，张绝忽然打开了院门，一把抓住他的衣袖猛地将他拽进了院子！
方勉被吓了一跳，等到看清是张绝以后，他才激动地喊道。
“绍先！”
“别说话，进屋，躲起来！就当家里没人！”张绝手脚麻利地重新锁上了大门，对外面那些发现了这里的动静，正在哭喊着拍门寻求庇护的人视而不见。
他从来只做自己力所能及的帮助，绝不会热血上头意气用事。
救下一个他了解秉性的熟人就足够了，再多，那就是让自己身处险境。
毕竟现在的他可还没被正式退学。
当张绝拽着方勉的胳膊回到屋内时，悄然间《太平道》某张画像下的进度条有了显著的增长，太平气的数值又增长了几点。
content_en:
Even though the students who held this demonstration had never looked down upon Zhang Jue, Zhang Jue clearly understood.
These students are truly thinking about the country and the people.
There is absolutely no possibility of restoring the old law.
Under the wave of the new era, the post-Golden Rat Demon who once relied on the old laws to rule and oppress this land is vulnerable to the new laws of the foreigners.
The world has changed. The century-old humiliation that lasted from the Later Jin Dynasty to the New Republic of China has proven the infeasibility of the old law. Only new ideas, new professions, and new customs can create a new path suitable for this land.
This is an undoubted truth whether it is in the Constitution of the New Republic of China, the teachings of the Fair Church, or in the hearts of countless people in this land!
The Governor of Jiangnan went to war over a sword related to the old law, which is perverse. The students' demonstrations are absolutely progressive and just actions.
Under such circumstances, even the most overbearing warlords will feel a headache, because the soldiers who surrender to their command are all professionals learning new methods, and they will not get much support even from their own people.
But An Huanran actually dared to order someone to be shot and arrested!
Zhang, who had ruled Jiangnan for nearly twenty years, had no idea what he was thinking, and he had no time to think about it.
The moment gunshots rang out and the military police began arresting people, the entire Jiangning City fell into chaos.
Whether they were students demonstrating or street vendors watching the excitement on the street, the military police beat everyone they saw and arrested students whenever they saw them.
Countless innocent passers-by were beaten to bloody heads, and students wearing civilized attire, regardless of whether they participated in the parade or not, were all severely beaten and arrested.
Jingshui Alley is not far from the main street where students gathered for demonstrations, and the unrest soon spread to this alley.
More than a dozen students fled here. Some of them were banging on the door in panic, hoping to seek shelter. Some simply climbed into the courtyard and found a place to hide without waiting for the owner's permission.
After Zhang Jue heard the reminder from Lao Zhang next door, he immediately hid at home and locked the door, but the sounds of movement outside could still be clearly heard in his ears.
"Woof woof woof!" Wangcai was barking, the voice was shrill and angry.
"Aunt! Aunt! Please! Help! Help! Let us go in and hide! Hide!"
"Ah! Don't hit me! Don't hit me! I have nothing against the commander! I'm just watching from the side! I'm just watching from the side!"
"You beasts who help the tyrants! An Huanran is risking the disdain of the world! He will be punished by God! You will be punished by God too!"
"Catch me! Take me away! Don't catch them! This matter has nothing to do with those innocent people!"
Through the crack in the door, Zhang Jue saw students fleeing in all directions being chased and beaten by military policemen waving batons behind them.
The originally peaceful Jingshui Lane seemed to have turned into a bloody execution ground in an instant.
Two students climbed over the wall and hid in Lao Liutou's house. Aunt Li next door hurriedly pulled the three students into the house and helped them hide before the military police chased them. There were also a few people who didn't look like students dressed up and were crying and patting the door of Lao Zhang's house.
At this moment, Zhang Jue saw a somewhat familiar figure running hurriedly through the alley.
Just when he was about to pass by Zhang Jue's house, Zhang Jue suddenly opened the courtyard door, grabbed his sleeve and pulled him into the courtyard!
Fang Mian was startled. When he saw clearly that it was Zhang Jue, he shouted excitedly.
"Shaoxian!"
"Stop talking, go into the house and hide! Just act like no one is home!" Zhang Jue quickly relocked the door, turning a blind eye to those outside who had noticed the movement and were crying and banging on the door to seek shelter.
He always only does what he can to help, and will never act out of passion.
saveAn acquaintance whom he understands is enough; any more would be putting himself in danger.
After all, he has not been officially expelled from school yet.
When Zhang Jue took Fang Mian's arm and returned to the house, the progress bar under a certain portrait in "Taiping Dao" quietly increased significantly, and the value of Taiping Qi increased by a few points.
